purpose: Reusable, claim-bounded registry of external materials-science datasets, papers, repositories, and model resources for MLIP, molecular dynamics, crystal-structure, high-pressure, finite-temperature, and phase-change research.
claim_guardrail: A source may support only the claims listed in its claim_support entries. State-condition evidence, phase labels, model capability, and accuracy-improvement claims must not be collapsed into one another.

ingestion_families.description: Read Hugging Face Dataset Viewer split/size/parquet metadata, then sample parquet rows into Lupine fixture manifests without downloading full corpora.
Track repository, model, and validation-test metadata as benchmark context or backend candidates.
Track paper/preprint claims and citation metadata. This adapter does not assert reusable data availability by itself.
Import trajectory archives or downloadable files after license and format checks pass.

claim_levels.ground_truth_reference: Can provide energy/force/stress/structure labels for direct evaluator rows, subject to method limitations.
claim_levels.state_condition_reference: Can provide finite-temperature, pressure, stress, ensemble, or trajectory-state context, but not necessarily phase labels.
claim_levels.phase_label_reference: Can provide phase labels or phase-resolved trajectories with provenance.
claim_levels.benchmark_context: Can guide benchmark design, leakage avoidance, or comparison framing but does not directly provide fixture labels.
claim_levels.model_comparison: Can be run as or compared against a model/backend, but is not treated as truth data.
claim_levels.metadata_only: Useful as an index or stewardship resource; requires downstream source-specific resolution before claims.

sources.title: OMat24 train AIMD from PBE 1000 NPT
sources.stewardship: Use the Hugging Face Dataset Viewer/parquet path first. Preserve ColabFit dataset DOI, OMat24 paper citation, DFT method, split/config, configuration_id, property_id, and metadata paths in every derived fixture row.

capabilities.temperature: dataset split encodes 1000 K AIMD/NPT intent; verify row-level metadata before scalar temperature claims
capabilities.pressure: NPT and cauchy_stress available; scalar pressure labels require metadata extraction or stress-derived convention

claim_support.guardrail: Supports finite-temperature AIMD/NPT energy-force-stress snapshots. Does not by itself support phase-change labels.
Treat 1000 K/NPT as source-level state context until row-level metadata is parsed.

ingestion.next_action: Sample a small element-balanced set from default/train, parse metadata for ensemble/temperature/pressure conventions, and preserve original configuration/property ids.

sources.title: OMat24 train AIMD from PBE 3000 NPT
sources.stewardship: Use as the high-temperature counterpart to the 1000 K NPT source. Keep it separated from low-temperature and relaxation trajectories so phase-boundary claims do not become temperature-only claims.

capabilities.temperature: dataset split encodes 3000 K AIMD/NPT intent; verify row-level metadata before scalar temperature claims
capabilities.pressure: NPT and cauchy_stress available; scalar pressure labels require metadata extraction or stress-derived convention

claim_support.guardrail: Supports hot AIMD/NPT energy-force-stress snapshots. Does not by itself say whether a row is liquid, amorphous, or crystalline.
Treat 3000 K/NPT as source-level state context until row-level metadata is parsed.

ingestion.next_action: Sample a small high-temperature counter-slice and compare order metrics against the 1000 K source before any phase label is assigned.

sources.title: LeMat-Traj: scalable unified materials trajectories
sources.stewardship: Use for broad trajectory coverage and support-distribution mapping. Preserve immutable_id, id, relaxation_step, relaxation_number, functional, and compatibility split.

capabilities.pressure: stress_tensor present; pressure requires derived convention

claim_support.guardrail: Excellent for broad energy/force/stress coverage. Do not infer finite-temperature phase labels.
Use as a source distribution map and negative-example reservoir, not as the sole state/phase truth source.

ingestion.next_action: Build a tiny stratified sample across compatibility configs, chemistry size, stress magnitude, and relaxation step.

sources.title: Materials Project trajectory data used by CHGNet/MPtrj
sources.license: Materials Project and Figshare terms apply; verify before redistributing subsets.
sources.stewardship: Continue using as the canonical relaxation-trajectory source for current heldout/support fixtures. Keep clear that it is not a controlled finite-temperature phase-change source.

capabilities.pressure: stress tensors present; scalar pressure requires derived convention

claim_support.guardrail: Supports DFT relaxation accuracy and broad MLIP heldout rows, not finite-temperature or phase-change labels.

evidence.docs_state: Materials Project docs describe energies, forces, stresses, structures, and magnetic moments from ionic step data.

ingestion.next_action: Retain as the relaxation-control source while using OMat24/GST/HPCSD to fill state and phase gaps.

sources.title: Data for modeling Ge2Sb2Te5 phase-change memory material with a machine-learned interatomic potential
sources.license: Repository-specific; verify file license before redistribution.
sources.stewardship: Use as the first narrow phase-change data source only after archive file formats and reuse terms are inspected. Preserve trajectory origin, phase state, temperature, and potential/model provenance.

capabilities.temperature: trajectory metadata expected; verify per file

claim_support.guardrail: Use for GST phase-change behavior only. Do not generalize to all crystals or pressure regimes.

evidence.known_content: Trajectories of glass and liquid Ge2Sb2Te5 models generated with GAP.

ingestion.next_action: Inspect downloadable files, license, phase labels, and trajectory schema; import only a tiny provenance-preserving sample.

sources.title: Unraveling crystallization kinetics of Ge2Sb2Te5 with a machine-learned interatomic potential
sources.license: Nature article license; verify supplementary data terms before reuse.
sources.stewardship: Use for phase-label taxonomy, order-parameter design, and GST-focused claims. Do not treat paper text as reusable fixture data unless supplementary data are explicitly ingested.

capabilities.structures: paper reports phase-resolved configuration database; data access must be verified

claim_support.guardrail: Use as taxonomy and methodology until data files are resolved.

ingestion.next_action: Resolve supplementary data and convert methods into measurable phase-label fields.

sources.title: High-Pressure Crystal Structure Database
sources.license: arXiv/preprint and database terms must be checked before importing data.
sources.stewardship: Use as a pressure-resolved structure registry candidate. Only ingest entries with traceable pressure, structure, source, and license metadata.

capabilities.phase_label: pressure-resolved structural phase labels possible; verify database schema

claim_support.guardrail: Pressure-structure provenance only. Does not provide energy/force/stress evaluator labels unless linked back to calculations.

evidence.reported_role: pressure-resolved experimental and theoretical high-pressure structures

ingestion.next_action: Locate database files/API and verify license before treating HPCSD as an ingestable source.

sources.title: MatterSim v1 atomistic model across elements, temperatures, and pressures
sources.license: Repository/model license applies; verify exact checkpoint terms before production use.
sources.stewardship: Use as a backend/comparison lens and source of temperature-pressure task framing. Report exact checkpoint, e.g. MatterSim-v1.0.0-1M or 5M.

capabilities.trajectory: can generate simulations but not source truth

claim_support.guardrail: MatterSim predictions are model outputs, not ground-truth labels for Distill accuracy claims.
Use for protocol design and comparison, not as a replacement for source-labeled fixtures.

ingestion.next_action: Add as a candidate runner backend only after local/cloud environment and checkpoint license checks pass.

sources.title: OpenKIM repository of interatomic models, tests, verification checks, and reference data
sources.license: model/test/result specific; OpenKIM DOI and object license must be preserved per item.
sources.stewardship: Use for model IDs, validation tests, reference data, and computed-property result provenance. Do not mix predictions from classical potentials with DFT reference labels unless the role is explicit.

claim_support.guardrail: OpenKIM test results are excellent validation/comparison records, but model predictions are not DFT truth labels.
Use as a reusable benchmark design source and adapter target.

ingestion.next_action: Build an OpenKIM query adapter for model/test/property metadata after the first state-phase seed lands.

sources.title: ColabFit Exchange
sources.license: dataset-specific; ColabFit records include per-dataset terms.
sources.stewardship: Use as the general discovery index for additional MLIP datasets. Promote only individual dataset records after their own license/citation/field verification passes.

claim_support.guardrail: Repository-level metadata does not authorize fixture use; each dataset needs a source entry.

evidence.role: MLIP dataset discovery and curation hub

ingestion.next_action: Use as a discovery catalog after the first OMat24/GST/HPCSD source adapters are operational.

sources.title: NIST Interatomic Potentials Repository
sources.license: potential-specific; cite NIST IPR and original potential papers.
sources.stewardship: Use as classical-potential provenance and baseline index. Keep each implementation id and original paper attached to any local LAMMPS result.

claim_support.guardrail: Provides provenance for classical baselines, not MLIP or DFT ground truth.

methods: Repository URL previously used in source packet and checked in current source search

ingestion.next_action: Keep synchronized with existing Ni source packet; add system pages only when a benchmark lane selects that chemistry.

registry: Every source has source_id, title, source_kind, URL records, citation metadata, license, stewardship, capabilities, claim_support, verification, and ingestion fields.
Every claim_support entry has a claim_id, known claim level, evidence fields, and guardrail.
A source cannot support phase_label_reference unless its capabilities.phase_label is truthy.
A ready_for_sampler source must have at least one verified live or verified local check.
state_phase_seed_v1: At least one source supports state_condition_coverage.
At least one distinct source supports phase_change_labels or phase_label_reference.
Every imported row preserves source_id, citation_key, license note, original id, and source-specific provenance fields.
State-condition labels and phase labels remain separate fields until an evaluator explicitly joins them.
general_reuse: Campaigns cite this registry by path and source_ids rather than retyping source claims.
Adapters consume source capability/claim metadata before downloading or sampling large datasets.
Phoenix/Lupine Science reports show claim level and guardrail next to any sourced evidence.
